nodes.label: RefineCalculator
nodes.rationale: Pure calculation that does not mutate data, so it is safe to call from a background thread.

nodes.label: Fetch on background thread, Apply on UI thread
nodes.norm_label: fetch on background thread, apply on ui thread
nodes.rationale: Only Fetch (WinHTTP request and JSON parse) runs in background; the render thread polls IsReady in Update then Applies results, avoiding data races.

nodes.label: Tab (planned): 전투력 시뮬레이터
nodes.rationale: Computation runs in the browser on lopec.kr, so the crawler only changes displayed values and reads results without server load; loalab is blocked by Cloudflare so manual measurement sheets are kept.

nodes.label: APPConstants
nodes.rationale: Collects constants so numbers and strings are never hard-coded in code.

nodes.label: DPAPIKeyStore
nodes.rationale: API key is encrypted with Windows DPAPI so only the same Windows user account can decrypt it.

nodes.label: JSONFileStore
nodes.rationale: Atomic save via temp file then replace, plus .bak backup; on read failure falls back to backup, then to empty data with a notice.

nodes.label: Platform (OS interface)
nodes.rationale: UI controls do not call Windows directly; the real implementation is Views::MainWindow.

nodes.label: ServerConfigChecker / GistServerConfigChecker
nodes.rationale: Remote config on a GitHub Gist provides a maintenance switch, latest version and notices without redeploying.

nodes.label: Custom UI controls (Control, ControlHost, Grid, TextBox, LineChart, Dialog...)
nodes.norm_label: custom ui controls (control, controlhost, grid, textbox, linechart, dialog...)
nodes.rationale: Self-drawn widgets rendered with Direct2D rather than native Win32 controls.

nodes.label: Dependency injection via ToolContext
nodes.rationale: Shared services are handed to each tab manager in Initialize so tabs depend on interfaces, not concrete implementations.

nodes.label: 계층 구조 (Models/Core/Services/UI/Views)
nodes.rationale: Dependencies flow downward; Views only know Core interfaces, while concrete Services are created by Application and injected.
